description: The halo overlays (ADR 0027, Athena is ambient): one click-through window per monitor, labelled `halo-<i>`, each holding exactly one privileged webview that draws the screen edges from the `halo:signal` event. They are listen-only: events and nothing else, no command of the app's and no window control. The `athena` window is the halo's only producer, through `athena_halo` in `athena.json`.
